title: SDK & API Launch Campaign: structured streaming samples, call-schema migration guide, and partner enablement
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Coordinate cross-functional launch for SDK + API surface updates (function calling + structured output + streaming). Deliver localized sample kits, partner enablement materials, a call-schema migration guide, and an internal runbook for staged rollout and rollback. This ticket centralizes launch tasks, timelines, and post-launch telemetry gating for GA release.
checklist: Finalize compatibility shim & deprecation timeline for older function-calling payloads
Ship localized sample packs (JS, Python, Go) with streaming + structured examples
Publish call-schema migration guide and automated code snippets for common SDKs
Prepare partner enablement deck + partner engineering office hours schedule
Coordinate console feature flags and per-customer rollout cohorts
Create observability dashboard template and A/B telemetry queries
Draft release notes and migration FAQ for public docs
Prepare rollback and failover runbook for degraded model variants
acceptance_criteria: Sample kits published in docs and GitHub with CI for linting and test snippets
Migration guide reviewed and signed off by runtime eng and SDK leads
Partner enablement slide deck and one-pager uploaded to Drive (shared)
Console feature flags tested in staging and ready for per-customer gating
Telemetry queries instrumented and baseline collected for 72 hours
Release notes drafted, legal/comms approvals in place, and translation plan scheduled
